QWEN LORAS:

I put them in but not finding them useful. I think these are a bit anime or just challenging to work with. Need further tests.

---

https://huggingface.co/peteromallet/Qwen-Image-Edit-InStyle

instyle - "Make an image in this style of"  (MBEDIT - so far this is cartoon ish)

---

https://www.modelscope.ai/models/Martis/nextscene/summary?version=20260114113354

next scene - trigger word "nextscene"

---

https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap

best face swap lora - "face swap face from Image 1 to Image 2." or 
		- "face swap face from Image 1 to Image 2. swap only the face (not the hair), match the skin tone to Image 2, keep Image 2 pose and lighting."
		- head swap from Image 1 to Image 2 with perfect skin match
		- Head swap from Image 1 to Image 2, keep all facial details and hair from Image 1, blend naturally with Image 2’s body.
		- head swap face from Image 1 to Image 2, keep all facial details and hair from Image 1, blend naturally with Image 2’s body, remove all hair of Image 2 and replace by hair from Image 1 and keep the same expression and head proportion as in Image 2

# RELIGHTING (No Lora):

(I tried with instyle lora but it was too strong maybe should have set to 0.5 not 1 strength, the below is not using the lora)

- "relight image 1 in the style of image 2"
- reduce denoise around 0.5 to 0.7 (can swap face in after. non-faces will be improved, just faces look plastic distilled)
- (Zimage v low denoise after will improve but risk losing face too high)

TRICK: do 0.7 strength restyle then use Krita to blend the lighting under the original. probably as good as it gets if losing consistency.

# FACE SWAP (w Lora):

use the "best face swap lora" is pretty good. tried only with strength 1.0.
 - set sampler denoise 1.0 will do almost straight swap (to strong no style blending happens)
 - 0.75 will blend better.
 - 0.5 will be half between and helps QWEN do its thing
 - 0.35 around this blends the best but sometimes isnt quite right structurally. test and measure.
face swap from image 2 to image 1

nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
|   | Qwen | Comfy | lightning LoRA |
|--------|---------|------------|---------------------------|
| Steps  | 40      | 20         | 4                         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 4.0       | 1.0                       |

By default, we use 20 steps as we just don't want it to take too long. Try 40 if you want a better result, but it will take longer.
The "Edit Model Reference Method" nodes above are not needed if you use Comfy files, but may be needed if you use repackaged ones from other people.
